review_description: From start to finish, Chez and the team at Everlite were so efficient and easy to deal with. The whole process was made so easy and they were happy to answer any questions. The installation was great, the team worked so efficiently. When they left, you wouldn’t have even known they were there with how tidy they left the place. The panels also look so neat and sleek compared to others I have seen. Chez spent time showing me how to use the app and explained how it all works. We couldn’t be happier with Everlite, will be recommending them to all our friends and family.

Chez, René and the installation team couldn’t have been any more professional, reliable, and helpful right through from initial enquiry, to commissioning the system with our power company. They designed the system for maximum efficiency, located the inverter in the most suitable place, explained the operation and tracking on the app of the solar vs grid usage, and were unbelievably tidy. I highly recommend Everlite, and will look at using them to switch my gas hot water to electric next.

Great service. From the initial enquiry Everlite were there the next day and had the quote to me within hours. Assisted with the Solar Victoria rebate application and within 10 days the Tesla Powerwall was connected to complete our solar system. Friendly and informative installers who answered all questions and kept me in the loop at all times. Highly recommended.Everlite have since added additional panels to my system and lived up to the excellent service and work done on the first installation. Again highly recommended.

Excellent service.  Very efficient workers and quite patient in setting up and explaining the App on the phone to a couple of "seniors".  Very happy to recommend Chezlin and team to other prospective purchasers of a solar system.

From start to finish Rene and Chezlin have been great to work with. Great experience, the help/advice Rene has given me has been outstanding every step of the way. She has made the process so much easier and seamless.The day of instalment Chezlin and his team very professional. Checking explain everything that was happening what would happen.I can not speak highly enough of Everlite.Reassurance of great after service if required…Highly recommended thank you Rene and Chezlin and your team.Sue

quoting and sales very informative regarding to what we are expecting.installation is professional, tidy, does not require to clean after work completed.punctuality on time.after installation is completed, assist and explain in details with easy to understand language.

They were happy to respond to my many questions and were patient along the way. Their communication was great along the way.They weren't pushy with the sales. The team spent the whole day installing the system and did not rush off to another job. They took their time making sure everything was working. The only minor hiccup was on the behalf of Goodwe who uploaded the wrong version of the firmware. Fortunately, Chez was monitoring the situation and made sure they rectified the issue the next day.Thank Chez, Rene and the team at Everlite Electrical.

Great Experience!From start to finish the Team at Everlite were able to answer all the queries I had.The install was done at a high standard and great communication throughout the stages.Thank You again Chez and the Everlite Team!Highly Recommend.

The solar panels have not only exceeded expectations but have also proven to be a significant value for money investment, resulting in noticeable cost savings on my energy bills.The SEMS Portal app has brought added convenience and significant value to my investment, making the transition to solar energy a truly rewarding experience. Chez took the time to explain its functionalities, allowing me to monitor and optimise energy production.In conclusion, I highly recommend Everlite Electrical for their outstanding service and high-quality products. Thank you, Chez, for a seamless and positive experience! Highly recommended!

Extremely happy with the service provided from quote to installation. They were quite happy to accommodate all the requests I had including the type of equipment and system size. Thank you so much Everlite and we are enjoying our new solar system. Would definitely recommend it to anyone.

We are so happy with our experience with Everlite Electrical! From the initial quote process, which was thorough and clear, to the installation day, we were thrilled with the service that we received. The team at Everlite Electrical are quick to respond to any queries and got on with the job in a timely manner. their workmanship was fantastic, and just as importantly, they are a company you can trust. If you're making a costly purchase, such as a solar system, it's natural to have some worries. However, my experience with this company was seamless. Rene, who was highly skilled, provided me with several quotes as I explored various options. The process was smooth, and Chez expertly coordinated the installation. Overall, I had a fantastic experience dealing with this company, and I highly recommend them for your solar installation needs.
Everlite did a great job with our solar from start from finish! Chezlin was very helpful and approachable and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend him and his team to anyone wanting to install solar.

From the time of first contact right through to installation, Everlite Electrical were fantastic to deal with.  I was given clear recommendations and options that would future proof the installation.  Our first installation was for a 7kw Wallbox to charge an EV.  I had done my research and knew what I thought would be a fair price to pay.  I first approached a different company and their quote was outrageous, Everlite Elec were spot on.  Once I accepted the quote, Rene was quick to organise a date that suited us both.  Chez and team turned up on time, confirmed I was happy with what they planned to do, kept me informed and stepped me through how to operate the charger on completion of the work.  Perfect.  I was so impressed with the whole process I decided to ask for advice on Solar to offset the charger.....a few weeks later I had a 5.5kw system installed that can be upagraded to battery storage at a later date.  Once again everything went as planned.  We've now organised for Chez to install a similar system at my mother-in-law's.  Rene made the whole process easy to follow and ensured that any government subsidy entitlements were applied for and received, a painless experience for me.  It was a pleasure to deal with such a professionally run family business.
We had a great service from the get go. Both Rene and Chezlin took time to answer all our questions and were friendly, patient, informative and professional. Highly recommend Everlite for Solar.

Everlite Electrical have been exceptional through out the entirety of my journey in getting a solar system installed on our roof.They were accomodating with my specific requirements for: system size, positioning of panels on roof, preferred inverter brand and smart monitoring; and provided me with a quotation which satisfied my requirements and budget.Installation was completed in one day. During the installation they were easily approachable for any of my questions. After completion, they did a walk-through with me for the work which had been completed, showed me how to safely turn on/off the PV system, and assisted me with the commissioning of the Goodwe SEMS and Solar Analytics apps; as well as what is to be expected with regard to the electrical inspection and next steps with our DNSP and notifying our power retailer. They left the premises clean and tidy and took away their own rubbish.Clear and concise documentation was provided after installation.Customer service after installation has been exceptional as well. Everlite organises the grid connection and provided updates via email and phone calls with regards to the DNSP and our power retailer.Overall, an exceptionally positive experience.
